# `apiStabilityLeak`

Reports exported APIs whose public surface exposes a less stable type

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Maintainers |
| Default severity | `off` |
| Fixable | No |
| Effect versions | v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377137`, `TS377138` |
| Language Service name | `apiStabilityLeak` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/api-stability-leak` |

## Preview

```ts
/** @stability experimental */
export interface PreviewExperimental {
  value: string
}

export interface PreviewStable {
/**
                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(api-stability-leak): `effect-v4-tests/preview#PreviewStable` exposes `PreviewExperimental`, an experimental API.
*/
  leaked: PreviewExperimental
}
```

      }
